build_ctc_graph: build a CTC graph from a target label sequence and blank token using ctc_graph
build_emissions_graph: build a linear emissions graph from a probability vector with emissions_graph
test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC loss computation by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward score
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG loss by composing emissions with transitions and a finite automaton graph
test_viterbi_path: test the Viterbi decoding path by composing emissions and transitions graphs then extracting labels
